text:
Alicia: heads up — the node SDK's deleteRoute is returning a 200 success for a route that the REST API returns 404 for. This is breaking the sampleapp onboarding flow when it tries to clean up test routes.

Jamie: hmm that's bad. can you paste a minimal repro? which sdk version?

Alicia: repro below (node 18, sdk@2.4.0):

```js
// sdk call
await client.routes.delete({ routeId: 'nonexistent-abc' });
// returns: { ok: true } (no error)
```

Alicia: curl to the same backend: 

```bash
curl -i -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.example/v1/routes/nonexistent-abc" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
# -> HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
```

Jamie: thanks. quick guess: SDK might be normalizing delete responses (idempotent semantics) and swallowing 404. sdk should probably surface status codes. can you include request id/response headers from the SDK debug log?

Alicia: here's the SDK debug snippet (filtered):

"Request DELETE /v1/routes/nonexistent-abc -> 204 [handled by client layer]"

Alicia: sampleapp expects an error so it can recreate the route; because sdk returns success nothing gets recreated and onboarding fails.

Ryan: fwiw the platform will sometimes return 204 for deletes when the resource is already gone, but it should never map a 404 to a 200 at the client layer without exposing that mapping. looks like the SDK has a compatibility layer that converts certain errors to success for "idempotent" endpoints.

Maya: quick workaround in sampleapp: check for existence after delete and if not present recreate. pushing a small patch now — will revert once SDK fix is out. cc @Jamie :eyes:

Jamie: created a ticket and a draft PR to stop treating 404 as success for delete-like endpoints. TL;DR: SDK will expose rawStatus on the response and throw for non-2xx unless caller opts into idempotent-quiet mode. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/999 (draft) :bug:

Alicia: awesome. we should also add a test that ensures sampleapp onboarding fails on the same conditions in CI so we catch regressions.

ops-bot: Created issue RED-4571 for "SDK: delete should not swallow 404 for routes" assigned to @Jamie, priority P2.

Jamie: plan — ship fix in 2.4.1, include a migration note in changelog, and update sampleapp in patch release. ETA EOD tomorrow. anyone object?

Ryan: no objections. tracking in the release notes and the rolling canary.

Alicia: thanks all :thumbsup:
